name: smwpatches-widescreen-overworld
title: Widescreen Overworld
description:
Allows for the full horizontal screen as an overworld.

Hijacks: too many to name, look in the ASM file.
Doesn't use Free RAM.
Note that custom OW sprites need to be modified to include using the X position high bit in $0420 and up in their graphics routine.

Thanks to Vitor Vilela and Alcaro for helping me make this.
